def Afficher(t,n,tp,a,tn,b):
    print("Le tableau initial est: ")
    for i in range (n):
        print(t[i],end=" ")
    print("\nLes tableaux eclatés sont: ")
    for j in range(a):
        print(tp[j],end=" ")
    print("\t")
    for k in range(b):
        print(tn[k],end=" ")

n = Saisie()
Remplir(n)
a,b = Eclater(t,n)
Afficher(t,n,tp,a,tn,b)
